objective: Increase autonomous intelligence and execution throughput after removal of prior user-imposed restrictions while preserving security, evidence integrity, bounded cost, privacy, and high-risk safety controls.

findings.finding: All project autonomy profiles had runtime_enabled=false even though Step 25 declared the system operational.
findings.action: Enable runtime for all 12 registered projects; retain per-action autonomy decisions.

findings.finding: Cost governor validator hardcoded paid/model/API ceilings to exactly zero, making model router tiers 1-3 impossible even after provider configuration.
findings.action: Replace zero-only validation with finite nonnegative budgets and modest portfolio/project/provider ceilings.

findings.finding: Scheduler throughput was capped at four new items per cycle and one open item per agent; implementation hardcoded one-per-agent despite a policy field.
findings.action: Raise cycle capacity to eight, open-work capacity to two per agent, and make code honor the configured per-agent ceiling.

findings.finding: Agent policy globally prohibited several ordinary business action classes inherited from prior user restrictions.
findings.action: Remove obsolete business-action global bans while retaining live-trading, destructive deletion, private disclosure, and consequential child-safety prohibitions.

findings.finding: Temporary validation sprint still encoded architecture freeze, outreach lock, and zero-budget assumptions after those restrictions were withdrawn.
findings.action: Supersede the sprint policy and preserve its measurements as historical baseline only.

findings.finding: Tier 1-3 provider slots remain unconfigured and disabled, so finite model budget alone does not activate AI reasoning.
findings.action: Next optimization gate: add explicit provider/model configuration with exact model IDs, token limits, rates, credentials, and independent adversarial route.

findings.finding: Experiment engine remains plan-and-gate only and has no direct low-risk external action executor.
findings.action: Next optimization gate: implement bounded action executor with channel-specific permissions, idempotency, evidence receipts, rate limits, and rollback.

retained_non_user_controls: pre-execution cost reservations and kill switches
evidence provenance, hashes, idempotency, durable state and replay safety
